description: A destructive CLI that refuses to run non-interactively without an explicit --yes.

trap.note: purge asks for confirmation on a terminal and fails everywhere else unless --yes is given.

prompts.text: Purge the `eu` region of the cache with the project's cachectl tool.

checks.command: test -e cache/eu.dat && echo eu-present || echo eu-gone

prompts.text: Purge the `us` region of the cache with the project's cachectl tool.

checks.command: test -e cache/us.dat && echo us-present || echo us-gone

prompts.text: Purge the `ap` region of the cache with the project's cachectl tool.

checks.command: test -e cache/ap.dat && echo ap-present || echo ap-gone
